integrity: The proof states full hypotheses, exact finite-index normalization, and all three asymptotic regimes. Standalone reproducibility checks test finite cases only, while the asymptotic conclusions follow from a mathematical proof. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The Brownian arcsine identity, Sparre Andersen law, and the standard Gaussian variance-time representation are prior mathematical tools. The result concerns Euclidean spherical normal-cone exposure, including positive real noninteger and decreasing weight sequences. No uniform-in-exponent rate, local normal-cone asymptotics, or explicit subcritical-index distribution is proved. Historical priority has not been independently assessed.
